svg.title: Compose ACC Preview — requirements → AI crew → workflow diagram
svg.desc: Combined redesign of Swarm Composer. Keeps useful ui_03 components (architect banner, chat, structured recommendation, Common agent slots, goal chips, metrics, Save Draft, fail-closed notes) while centering AI-pick mainly: human writes requirements; AI binds available agents; primary output is an Agent-Workflow-style diagram. Human only for needs_hitl conflicts. Style: common-style.html (stone / indigo / white / Inter).
svg.text: Form a multi-agent work from available agents · requirements in · workflow diagram out · human only on conflicts
